text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength. What today did you try to control that was never yours to control?
We suffer more in imagination than in reality. What did you worry about today that turned out smaller than you feared?
It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters. Where today did you choose your response instead of being ruled by the event?
Waste no more time arguing about what a good person should be. Be one. Where did you act instead of debate today?
He who is brave is free. What fear did you face today, however small?
Man is disturbed not by things, but by the views he takes of them. What story did you tell yourself today, and was it true?
Every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end. What ended today that you can let go of?
If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it. Where did you hold this line today?
Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body. What difficulty today can you reframe as training?
First say to yourself what you would be, and then do what you have to do. Who are you trying to become, and did today's actions move you closer?
The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts. What quality of thought did you feed your mind today?
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking. What small shift in thinking today would have made you happier?
Confine yourself to the present. What is happening right now that deserves your full attention instead of worry about tomorrow?
How much trouble he avoids who does not look to see what his neighbor says or does. Whose business did you mind today that wasn't yours?
Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together. Who did fate put in your path today, and did you meet them with love?
Loss is nothing else but change, and change is Nature's delight. What change today did you resist that you could have welcomed instead?
Reject your sense of injury and the injury itself disappears. What injury did you carry today that existed only because you kept holding it?
The universe is change; our life is what our thoughts make it. What did your thoughts make of today?
When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive. Did you greet this morning as a gift, or as an inconvenience?
Let each thing you would do, say, or intend be like that of a dying person. What would you have done differently today if you'd remembered it might be your last?
Nowhere can a man find a quieter or more untroubled retreat than in his own soul. Where in yourself did you retreat to today when things got loud?
Do every act of your life as if it were your last. Which act today would you have done more carefully with that in mind?
The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury. Who wronged you today, and did you let it change who you are?
Everything we hear is an opinion, not a fact. Everything we see is a perspective, not the truth. What did you treat as fact today that was really just your opinion?
You could leave life right now. Let that determine what you do and say and think. Did today's words and actions reflect that seriousness, or did you waste them?
If it is not right, do not do it. If it is not true, do not say it. Your impulses are under your own control. Which impulse did you master today, and which one mastered you?
Dwell on the beauty of life. Watch the stars, and see yourself running with them. What beauty did you actually stop to notice today?
Never let the future disturb you. You will meet it with the same weapons of reason which today arm you against the present. What future worry borrowed against today's peace?
The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts. What color did your thoughts dye your soul today?
Choose not to be harmed and you won't feel harmed. Don't feel harmed and you haven't been. Where today did you choose to feel harmed when you didn't have to?
Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one. Where did today call for action instead of opinion, and which did you give it?

Adapt yourself to the things among which your lot has been cast, and love sincerely the people with whom fate has ordained that you shall live. Did you love the people around you today, or merely tolerate them?
How ridiculous and how strange to be surprised at anything which happens in life. What happened today that you resisted simply because you were surprised by it?
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way. What obstacle today can you turn into the path forward instead of a wall?
It is not death that a man should fear, but he should fear never beginning to live. What today did you put off living in favor of merely existing?
A man's worth is no greater than the worth of his ambitions. What did today's ambitions say about your worth?
Be content to seem what you really are. What mask did you wear today instead of simply being who you are?
Be tolerant with others and strict with yourself. Where today did you reverse that, excusing yourself while judging someone else?
The art of living is more like wrestling than dancing. What today required you to brace and hold your ground rather than glide gracefully through?
Time is a sort of river of passing events, and strong is its current. What passed you by today that you tried to hold onto?
Look well into thyself; there is a source of strength which will always spring up if thou wilt always look. When today did you look inward instead of searching outside yourself for strength?
How much more grievous are the consequences of anger than the causes of it. What did your anger cost you today, compared to what actually caused it?
Receive without pride, let go without attachment. What did you receive or release today, and which was harder?
Because a thing seems difficult for you, do not think it impossible. What did you avoid today only because it looked hard?
If any man despise me, that is his concern; my only concern is not to do or say anything deserving of contempt. Whose opinion did you let govern you today instead of your own conduct?
Not to assume it's impossible because you find it hard. Where today did difficulty masquerade as impossibility?
Take away your opinion, and there is taken away the complaint. What complaint melted away today once you set the opinion behind it aside?
Give yourself a gift: the present moment. Did you actually receive today's moments, or were you elsewhere the whole time?
Just as you would give a definite meaning to good and evil, so you should give one to human happiness. What did you define as good today, and did your actions agree?
Everything harmonizes with me which is harmonious to you, O Universe. What happened today that felt like misfortune but was really just the world proceeding as it must?
Nothing has such power to broaden the mind as the ability to investigate systematically and truly all that comes under thy observation in life. What did you truly examine today instead of assuming?
How happy is he who has never entertained a low opinion of himself. Did you speak kindly to yourself today, or repeat a low opinion you've never questioned?
The best way to avenge yourself is to not be like that. Where today did someone's bad behavior nearly pull you down to their level?
Do not indulge in dreams of having what you have not, but reckon up the chief of the blessings you do possess. What blessing did you overlook today while chasing something you lack?
Remember that man lives only in the present, in this fleeting instant. What fleeting instant today did you actually live in, rather than in memory or anticipation?
External things are not the problem. It's your assessment of them. Which assessment today made an ordinary event into a problem?
You have power over your mind, not outside events. Where today did you try to grip something that was never yours to hold?
Consider that everything which happens, happens justly, and if thou observest carefully, thou wilt find it to be so. What happened today that you resisted before really looking at it honestly?
He who lives in harmony with himself lives in harmony with the universe. Where today were you at odds with yourself before you were at odds with anyone else?
Do what is necessary, no more, and say what is necessary, no more. Where did you say or do more than the moment required today?
Even while it's happening to us, we can choose how to respond to it. What happened to you today, and did you remember you had a choice in the response?
Whatever anyone does or says, I must be emerald and keep my color. What tried to change your color today, and did you keep it?
The universe is transformation; our life is what our thoughts make it. What transformation did you resist today instead of moving with it?
If it's endurable, then endure it. Stop complaining. What did you endure today without needing to announce your suffering?
Be like the rocky headland on which the waves constantly break. It stands firm, and round it the seething waters are calmed. What waves broke against you today, and did you stand firm?
Our life is what our thoughts make it. Was today shaped more by what happened, or by how you thought about what happened?
You must build up your life action by action, and be content if each one achieves its goal as far as possible. Which single action today can you be content with, regardless of the outcome?
It is in your power to withdraw yourself whenever you desire. Perfect tranquility within consists in the good ordering of the mind. Where could you have withdrawn into calm today instead of chaos?
Think of yourself as dead. You have lived your life. Now take what's left and live it properly. What would you do differently tomorrow if today had already used up most of your allotted time?
Objective judgment, now, at this very moment. Unselfish action, now, at this very moment. What judgment or action does this very moment ask of you, right now?
Concentrate every minute like a Roman on doing what's in front of you with precise and genuine seriousness. What in front of you today deserved more seriousness than you gave it?

How much time he gains who does not look to see what his neighbor says or does or thinks, but only at what he does himself. How much time did you spend today watching others instead of tending your own conduct?
Stop letting your mind be a slave, to be jerked about by selfish impulses. What impulse today jerked you around before you noticed it happening?
You have power over your mind, not outside events. Practicing this daily is how strength is built. What did you practice today: control of your mind, or control of the uncontrollable?
A cucumber is bitter. Throw it away. There are briars in the road. Turn aside from them. This is enough. What bitter, small thing today did you turn into a bigger story than it deserved?
The universe is change; life is opinion. What opinion did you hold today that, if released, would have changed nothing but your suffering?
Be like a headland against which the waves break and break; it stands firm until the tumult around it subsides. What tumult around you today didn't need to move you?

Suppose that a god announced that you were going to die tomorrow or the day after. Unless you were a coward you wouldn't fuss about which day it was. What today did you fuss over that wouldn't matter if you knew your time was short?

Do not act as if you had ten thousand years to live. Death hangs over you. While you live, while it is in your power, be good. Where today did you act as though you had unlimited time to become who you want to be?
How many have already forgotten thee! How many will soon forget thee! What effort did you spend today chasing a reputation that time will erase anyway?
Let no act be done without a purpose. What did you do today without any purpose behind it at all?
Be free of passion and yet full of love. Where today could you have cared deeply without letting the caring become a storm?

Nothing can happen to any man which is not a human accident, nor to an ox which is not according to the nature of an ox. What happened to you today that was simply the ordinary business of being human?
Perform every act in life as though it were your last act. What act today, done that way, would you be proud to have as your final one?
Look beneath the surface; let not the several qualities of a thing nor its worth escape thee. What did you judge too quickly today without looking beneath the surface?
Take away thy opinion, and then there is taken away the complaint. What did you complain about today that vanished the moment you dropped the opinion attached to it?
If any man is able to convince me and show me that I do not think or act right, I will gladly change. Who could have corrected you today, if you'd been willing to listen?
It is not right to vex ourselves at things, for they care nothing about it. What thing outside your control did you vex yourself over today, though it never noticed?
Thou seest how few things, if a man stands by them, he is able to live a tranquil and godlike life. What one or two things today could you have simply stood by, and been at peace?
The universe is transformation: life is opinion. What transformation did today bring that your opinion turned into a hardship?
Wipe out the imagination. Stop the pulling of the strings. Confine yourself to the present. What imagined future or replayed past pulled your strings today instead of the present moment?
In the morning when thou risest unwillingly, let this thought be present: I am rising to the work of a human being. Did you rise today remembering the work you were made for?
Men exist for the sake of one another. Teach them then or bear with them. Who did you need to teach, or simply bear with, today?

Be not disgusted, nor discouraged, nor dissatisfied, if thou dost not succeed in doing everything according to right principles. Where did you fall short of your own principles today, and can you return to them tomorrow?
That which is not good for the swarm, neither is it good for the bee. What did you do today that served only you at the expense of those around you?

Reverence the faculty which produces opinion. On this faculty it entirely depends whether there shall exist in thy ruling part any opinion inconsistent with nature. What opinion did you let form today without examining it first?

How easy it is to repel and to wipe away every impression which is troublesome or unsuitable, and immediately to be in all tranquility. What troublesome impression today could you have simply wiped away sooner?
Let it be thy earnest and incessant care as a Roman and a man to perform what thou hast in hand with true and simple dignity. What task today deserved more dignity than you gave it?
Thou hast existed as a part. Thou shalt disappear into that which produced thee. What part did you play well today, in something larger than yourself?

Many grains of frankincense on the same altar: one falls before, another falls after; but it makes no difference. Did today's small worries about timing and order really make the difference you thought they did?
It is thy duty to leave another man's wrongful act there where it is. Whose wrongful act did you carry with you today instead of leaving it where it happened?
Constantly regard the universe as one living being, having one substance and one soul. Where today did you feel disconnected from other people, and what would it take to remember the connection?
Short is the little which remains to thee of life. Live as on a mountain. Did today feel like it was lived with the clarity of someone who knows time is short?

He who acts unjustly acts impiously. For as the universal nature has made rational animals for the sake of one another, he who transgresses her will is guilty of impiety towards the highest divinity. Did any of today's actions put your interest ahead of the good of those around you?
Do away with the opinion, I am harmed, and the harm is taken away. What harm today existed only because you kept telling yourself the story of being harmed?
That which does not make a man worse, how can it make his life worse? What happened today that felt like it made your life worse, though it didn't actually make you a worse person?
The best kind of revenge is not to become like the wrongdoer. Who wronged you today, and did you refuse to mirror their wrong?
Let opinion be taken away, and no man will think himself wronged. What was taken from you today only in your own estimation, not in fact?

How many after being celebrated by fame have been given up to oblivion; and how many who have celebrated the fame of others have long been dead. What did you chase today for the sake of being remembered, and does it actually matter?

Be like the promontory against which the waves continually break, but it stands firm and tames the fury of the water around it. What fury broke against you today, and where did your firmness come from?

Unhappy am I because this has happened to me. Not so, but happy am I, though this has happened to me, because I continue free from pain. What happened to you today that you could reframe from misfortune into evidence of your own resilience?
A man should be upright, not be kept upright. What today did you do out of genuine uprightness, and what did you do only because someone was watching?

The art of life is more like the wrestler's art than the dancer's, in respect of this, that it should stand ready and firm to meet onsets which are sudden and unexpected. What sudden onset today tested whether you were standing ready?
Retire into thyself. The rational principle which rules has this nature, that it is content with itself when it does what is just. What just act today, even a small one, was reward enough on its own?
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality. What did you imagine today that never actually came to pass?
Difficulties strengthen the mind as labor does the body. What difficulty today can you choose to see as training rather than misfortune?
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it. Where did today's time slip away unused?
source: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life

text: Life is long if you know how to use it. Did you use today, or merely spend it?
source: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life

text: While we wait for life, life passes. What were you waiting for today instead of living it?
As is a tale, so is life: not how long it is, but how good it is, is what matters. Was today a good chapter, regardless of its length?
He who is brave is free. What small fear did you face today, even if no one noticed?
Every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end. What ended today that you are ready to let go of?
No man was ever wise by chance. What wisdom did you actually work for today, rather than hope would arrive on its own?
The greatest obstacle to living is expectancy, which hangs upon tomorrow and loses today. What expectation of tomorrow cost you today?
source: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life

text: True happiness is to enjoy the present, without anxious dependence upon the future. Did you enjoy today on its own terms, or only as a stepping stone to something else?
Sometimes even to live is an act of courage. What did it take just to show up today?
Any man can die well who lived well. What did you do today that you'd want on the record of a life well lived?
It is the power of the mind to be unconquerable. What tried to conquer your mind today, and did it succeed?
Wherever there is a human being, there is an opportunity for kindness. Where did you find, or miss, that opportunity today?
Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life. Did you treat today as its own complete life, or as a placeholder for tomorrow?
The whole future lies in uncertainty: live immediately. What did you postpone today because of a future that isn't promised to you?
Only time can heal what reason cannot. What are you still trying to reason your way out of, that simply needs time?
If a man knows not to which port he sails, no wind is favorable. What was your port today, and did you sail toward it or just drift?
I judge you unfortunate because you have never lived through misfortune. What hardship today, in hindsight, actually made you stronger?
Nowhere is there a more agreeable retreat than a good friend. Which friend gave you refuge today, or which friend did you fail to be a refuge for?
Let us prepare our minds as if we'd come to the very end of life. Let us postpone nothing. What did you postpone today that deserved to be done now?
The mind that is anxious about the future is miserable. What future anxiety stole your peace today?
A gem cannot be polished without friction, nor a man perfected without trials. What friction today was actually polishing you?
Throw me to the wolves and I will return leading the pack. What setback today can you turn into leadership instead of defeat?
Sometimes the very fear of losing a thing is worse than the loss itself. What loss did you fear today more than you would have suffered from it?
The greatest cure for anger is delay. Where today would waiting a moment longer have changed how you responded?
We are more often frightened than hurt, and we suffer more from imagination than reality. What frightened you today more than it actually harmed you?
As long as you live, keep learning how to live. What did today teach you about how to live better?
Anger, if not restrained, is frequently more hurtful to us than the injury that provokes it. What anger today hurt you more than the thing that caused it?
He suffers more than necessary, who suffers before it is necessary. What did you suffer today in advance of anything actually happening?
Associate with people who are likely to improve you. Who did you spend time with today, and did they make you better?
It is not the man who has too little, but the man who craves more, that is poor. What did you crave today that you didn't actually need?
No one is more unhappy than the man who is never in adversity; for he is not permitted to prove himself. What adversity today let you prove something about yourself?
To be everywhere is to be nowhere. Where did your attention scatter today instead of settling anywhere long enough to matter?
The greatest wealth is a poverty of desires. What desire today, if you'd let it go, would have made you richer?
Hang on to your youthful enthusiasms - you'll be able to use them better when you're older. What enthusiasm from your younger self did you draw on today?
Show me a man who isn't a slave; one is a slave to sex, another to money, another to ambition. What were you a slave to today?
First learn the meaning of what you say, and then speak. What did you say today before you'd actually thought it through?
Sometimes it is an act of valor to postpone risk to another day; other times, courage means confronting it now. Which did today call for, and did you answer correctly?
The bravest sight in the world is to see a great man struggling against adversity. What struggle today, seen from outside, might have looked like bravery instead of failure?
A man who suffers before it is necessary, suffers more than is necessary. What tomorrow's problem did you drag into today's peace?
What need is there to weep over parts of life? The whole of it calls for tears. What part of today did you grieve too specifically, missing the larger perspective?
We should every night call ourselves to an account: what infirmity have I mastered today? What infirmity, however small, did you actually master today?
It is not the man who has little, but he who wishes for more, who is poor. What abundance did you already have today, before you went looking for more?
Sometimes even to live is an act of courage. What quiet courage did today ask of you, simply to keep going?
Rejoice only in that which proceeds from your own resources. What today's joy depended on something outside your control, versus something entirely your own?
He robs poor Peter to pay rich Paul, so to speak, with his own peace of mind. What peace of mind did you spend today buying something that wasn't worth it?
Study as if you expected to live forever; live as if you expected to die tomorrow. Did today lean too far toward one at the expense of the other?
It is a rough road that leads to the heights of greatness. What rough patch today might actually be part of the climb?
Language given to conceal our thoughts. Where today did your words hide what you actually felt?

Nothing, to my way of thinking, is a better proof of a well-ordered mind than a man's ability to stop just where he is and pass some time in his own company. Did you spend any time today in your own company, undistracted?
The whole of the future lies in uncertainty; live immediately. What certainty were you waiting on today before you allowed yourself to actually live?
A ship is safe in harbor, but that's not what ships are for. What harbor were you hiding in today instead of setting out?
In vain do they hasten, in vain do they hurry, who wish to have more than they can enjoy. What did you hurry toward today that you'd have no time left to actually enjoy?
source: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life

text: Man is a reasoning animal. Therefore man's good is not fulfilled in mere reason, but in perfect reason. Where today did you settle for reasoning half-way, instead of thinking something all the way through?
Sometimes we suffer for want of what we didn't even want until we saw someone else have it. What did you covet today only because you saw someone else with it?
The greatest loss of time is delay and expectation, which depend upon the future. What did you delay today, waiting for a better moment that never needed to come?
source: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life

text: It is the nature of the wise man to resist his own advancement if it is by unjust means. What shortcut did you decline today, even though it would have been easier?
The soul should be brought up in strict discipline, that it may not fail to obey. What discipline did you hold today that made obedience to your own values possible?
In order to be able to bear misery, cease to feel that you are miserable. What misery today grew larger because you kept narrating it to yourself?
No man is crushed by misfortune unless he has first been deceived by prosperity. What comfort today made adversity feel harder than it actually was?
There is no easy way from the earth to the stars. What today reminded you that worthwhile things rarely come easily?
The mind that is calm and untroubled has the power to rise above circumstance. What circumstance today tried to pull your calm down with it?
He who fears death will never do anything worthy of a man who is alive. What did fear of some small ending keep you from attempting today?
All cruelty springs from weakness. Where did a moment of weakness today tempt you toward cruelty instead of patience?
It is quality rather than quantity that matters. What did you do today with real quality, however small?
As long as we are among the living, let us cultivate our humanity. Who did you treat with a little more humanity today than the moment strictly required?
The best ideas are common property. What wisdom did you receive today that you didn't need to invent yourself, only to apply?

Everywhere means nowhere. When a person spends all their time in foreign travel, they end up with many acquaintances, but no friends. Did today deepen a real friendship, or just add another acquaintance?
To wish to be well is a part of becoming well. What small wish for improvement today did you actually follow with action?
Prosperity comes to us with fair colors painted on, but adversity has the power to fashion character. What adversity today, unglamorous as it was, actually shaped you?
Until we have begun to go without them, we fail to realize how unnecessary many things are. What did you go without today, and realize you never needed?
He who has begun is half done. What did you begin today that you had been putting off for far too long?

Success comes to the lowly and to the poorly talented, but the special characteristic of a great man is to triumph over the disasters and terrors of human life. What disaster, however small, did you triumph over today?
No one is laughable who laughs at himself. Where today could you have laughed at your own mistake instead of defending it?
Every man prefers belief to the exercise of judgment. What did you simply believe today instead of actually examining?
What progress have I made? I am beginning to be my own friend. Are you, today, more your own friend than you were yesterday?
It does not matter what you bear, but how you bear it. How did you carry today's burden, regardless of its size?
Sometimes the greatest voyage is the one that stays in port. What did you resist chasing today, choosing stillness instead?
Real happiness is to enjoy the present, without anxious dependence upon the future, and not to amuse ourselves with either hopes or fears. What hope or fear kept you from enjoying today?
Many things are poisonous to us if taken into a soul that isn't strong enough to bear them. What did you take in today that your soul wasn't ready for, and how did you handle it?
Only the educated are free. What did today teach you that made you a little freer than before?
No man is free who is not master of himself. Where today did you lose mastery of yourself, even briefly?
Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens. What was actually in your power today, and did you use it well?
He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not, but rejoices for those which he has. What did you have today that you failed to rejoice in?
Circumstances do not rise to meet our expectations. Events happen as they do. What expectation today did reality simply refuse to meet, and how did you handle the gap?
It is impossible for a man to learn what he thinks he already knows. What did you assume you understood today, without actually examining it?
Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants. What want today did you satisfy, and what want could you have simply released?
If you want to improve, be content to be thought foolish and stupid. Where today did the fear of looking foolish stop you from trying something new?
Any person capable of angering you becomes your master. Who became your master today by successfully making you angry?
He who has learned how to die has unlearned how to be a slave. What small death, of ego or plan, did you accept today without resistance?
Do not seek for things to happen the way you want them to; rather, wish that what happens happen the way it happens. What today refused to go your way, and could you have simply let it be?
Men are disturbed not by the things which happen, but by the opinions about the things. What opinion, once removed, would have taken your disturbance with it today?
It is not he who reviles or strikes you who insults you, but your opinion that these things are insulting. What did you decide was an insult today, before you'd even examined it?
Seek not that the things which happen should happen as you wish; but wish the things which happen to be as they are. What happened today that you're still wishing had gone differently?
Freedom is the only worthy goal in life. Won by disregarding things that lie beyond our control. What did you disregard today that was never yours to control?
Keep silence for the most part, and speak only when you must, and then briefly. Where today would silence have served you better than the words you chose?
If you wish to be a writer, write. Whatever you want to become, what did you actually practice today toward becoming it?
We cannot choose our external circumstances, but we can always choose how we respond to them. What circumstance today tested your response more than your control?
Don't explain your philosophy. Embody it. Where today did you talk about your values instead of simply living them?
He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not, but rejoices for those which he has. What abundance did you take for granted today?
Never say of anything, I have lost it, but say I have restored it. What did you lose today that was only ever on loan?

It is difficult to combine and unite these two things - the carefulness of a man who is affected by circumstances, and the courage of one who is not affected by them. Where today did you find that balance, or fail to?
Persist and resist. Persist in your effort, and resist the temptation to give up. What did today ask you to persist through?
If evil be spoken of you and it be true, correct yourself; if it be a lie, laugh at it. What criticism today deserved correction, and what deserved a laugh?
Every habit and capability is confirmed and grows in its corresponding actions. What habit did today's actions confirm and strengthen in you?
When you are offended at any man's fault, turn to yourself and study your own failings. Then you will forget your anger. Whose fault irritated you today, and what did it mirror in yourself?
Practice yourself, for heaven's sake, in little things, and then proceed to greater. What little thing did you practice today, in preparation for something bigger?
If you would be a reader, read; if a writer, write. What did you actually do today, versus merely intend?
There is only one way to happiness and that is to cease worrying about things which are beyond the power of our will. What worry today was never within your power to resolve?
Progress is not achieved by luck or accident, but by working on yourself daily. What work did you actually put into yourself today?

It's the act of a stupid man to blame others for his own misfortune; of one who has begun to learn, to lay the blame on himself; and of one whose education is completed, neither to blame another, nor himself. Whom did you blame today, and where are you in that progression?
Demand not that things happen as you wish, but wish them to happen as they do happen, and you will go on well. What today did you demand of reality instead of accepting it?
Man is not worried by real problems so much as by his imagined anxieties about real problems. What imagined version of a problem today was worse than the problem itself?
Small-minded people blame others. Average people blame themselves. Wise people see all blame as foolish. Who did you blame today, and could you have simply let blame go?
You are a little soul carrying around a corpse. What did you carry today that weighed more on your soul than it needed to?
Attach yourself to what is spiritually superior, regardless of what other people think or do. What did you stay attached to today, even when it wasn't popular?

It is the act of an ill-instructed man to blame others for his own bad condition; it is the act of one who has begun to be instructed, to lay the blame on himself. Did you look inward or outward first today when something went wrong?
Nothing is really enjoyed, nor properly cared for, unless it's shared. What good thing today did you enjoy more because you shared it with someone?
It's not the man who has too little, but the man who craves more, that is poor. What did you crave today that added nothing to your actual life?
Any person capable of angering you becomes your master; he can anger you only when you permit yourself to be provoked by him. Who tried to provoke you today, and did you grant them the permission?
Don't just say you have read books. Show that through them you have learned to think better. What did you actually think better about today, because of what you'd learned before?
Control thy passions lest they take vengeance on thee. What passion today, left unchecked, would have taken its vengeance if you hadn't reined it in?
The key is to keep company only with people who uplift you, whose presence calls forth your best. Who did you spend time with today, and did they call forth your best?
First learn the meaning of what you say, and then speak. What did you say today before you'd fully understood it yourself?
Only the wise possess ideas; the majority only possess prejudices. What today did you treat as settled fact when it was really just an inherited prejudice?
He knows not his own strength that hath not met adversity. What adversity today revealed a strength you didn't know you had?

Don't seek to have events happen as you wish, but wish them to happen as they do happen, and your life will go smoothly. What today would have gone more smoothly if you'd simply accepted it as it was?
Which of us has not lost something dear to us? A thing was only ever on loan; today, or in the future, it will be reclaimed. What did today ask you to release with grace instead of grief?
Appear not learned in words, but let your virtue be shown in your deeds. Where today did you talk about being a good person more than you actually acted like one?
Difficulties are things that show a person what they are. What difficulty today showed you something true about yourself?
If you know an artisan willing to teach, be willing to be taught. What today were you willing to be taught, instead of insisting you already knew?
It is not sufficient to know how one ought to live, one must also do what one knows. What did you know was right today, and did you actually do it?
Of all human activities, none is superior to farming, none more suited to a life of virtue. What ordinary, humble work today did you dignify by doing it well?
Virtue is not just theoretical knowledge, but is practical knowledge, like the art of medicine or of music. What virtue did you actually practice today, rather than just think about?
Since it is impossible to check every appetite completely, one must guard against those that are troublesome. What appetite today needed less indulgence and more guarding?
The best way to teach philosophy is to live it. Who saw your philosophy today only through how you acted, not what you said?
Endurance of hardship voluntarily undertaken prepares one for hardship that comes unbidden. What voluntary discomfort today built your capacity to face what you can't control?
Lead me, Zeus, and you, Destiny, wherever you have assigned me. I shall follow unhesitatingly. Where did you resist today's assignment instead of following it?
The willing, destiny guides them; the unwilling, destiny drags. Were you guided today, or dragged?
Nothing happens to the wise man against his expectation. What surprised you today only because you hadn't prepared your mind for it?
Well-being is realized by small steps, but is truly no small thing. What small step today, easy to dismiss, was actually part of something significant?
The goal of life is living in agreement with nature. Did today's choices align with your nature, or fight against it?
source: Zeno of Citium, founding principle of Stoicism

text: Fate leads the willing, and drags the unwilling. What did you resist today that you could have simply walked into?
Man conquers the world by conquering himself. What part of yourself did you conquer today, rather than the world outside you?
No evil is honorable, but death is honorable; therefore death is not evil. What did you fear today that, examined honestly, was not actually the evil you assumed?
We are not to give up philosophy so long as we live, nor are we to delay it. What excuse did you make today to delay the work of becoming better?

There is nothing shameful in an involuntary movement of fear or grief, so long as we do not consent to it. What fear or grief moved through you today without you handing it your consent to control you?
The wise man asks not whether a thing is pleasant, but whether it is right. What did you choose today because it was right, even though it wasn't pleasant?
I would rather be right than be President. What today did you get right, even if no one applauded it?
It is a great thing to know the season for speech and the season for silence. Which season did today call for, and which did you choose?
Men in general are quick to praise virtue but slow to imitate it. Did you praise a virtue today that you also practiced, or only admired from a distance?
Grasp the subject, the words will follow. What did you actually understand deeply today, before you tried to explain it to anyone?
A wise man never refuses anything to necessity. What necessity did you fight today instead of simply meeting?
Nothing is so intolerable as good fortune accompanied by no understanding. What good fortune today did you fail to actually appreciate or understand?
The life given us, by nature, is short; but the memory of a well-spent life is eternal. What did you do today worth remembering?
To be ignorant of what occurred before you were born is to remain always a child. What did you learn today from something older than yourself?
Virtue is the one and only thing that is wholly our own. What did you build today that no circumstance could ever take away from you?
source: Cicero, On the Ends of Good and Evil

text: The whole glory of virtue is in activity. Was today's virtue active, or did it stay a private opinion you never acted on?
Cultivate friendship, for nothing else so satisfies our nature. Which friendship did you tend to today, and which did you neglect?
A room without books is like a body without a soul. What did you feed your mind today, and was it worth the feeding?

What is morally wrong can never be advantageous, even when it enables you to make some gain that you believe to be to your advantage. What shortcut today looked advantageous but wasn't actually right?
Never less alone than when by himself. When were you alone today, and was it lonely or was it company enough?
Rest is not idleness, and to lie sometimes on the grass under trees is not a waste of time. Did you allow yourself real rest today, or did you call busyness virtue?
source: Diogenes Laertius, Lives of Eminent Philosophers

text: Even in a palace, life may be led well. What today, in ordinary circumstances, gave you the chance to live well anyway?
Choose the life that is most excellent, for custom will soon render it the most delightful. What excellent habit did you practice today, even before it felt natural?
source: attributed to Pythagoras, adopted by Stoic tradition

text: The Stoics taught that only virtue is truly good, and only vice is truly bad; everything else - health, wealth, reputation - is merely preferred or dispreferred. What today did you treat as truly good or bad, when it was really only preferred?
The Stoic exercise of the view from above: imagine looking down on your life, your city, the earth, from a great height. Seen from that height, how large was today's trouble, really?

Premeditatio malorum: the practice of rehearsing what could go wrong before it happens, not to court misfortune but to rob it of its shock. What could you have prepared for today, and did the preparation make it easier to bear?
The evening review: before sleep, ask what you did well, what you did badly, and what you left undone. Answer honestly for today.

The morning preparation: before the day begins, rehearse that you will meet the meddling, the ungrateful, and the unjust, and resolve to remain unmoved by them. Did this morning's rehearsal hold up against what actually happened?
The dichotomy of control: some things are up to us, and some things are not. Sort today's frustrations into the two piles. How many belonged in the second?
Voluntary discomfort: choosing minor hardship on purpose, so real hardship later finds you less afraid of it. What small discomfort did you choose today, and what did it teach you?
Amor fati - the love of one's fate, not merely acceptance of it. What today would you have loved instead of merely tolerated, if you'd fully practiced amor fati?
source: Stoic practice, popularized by Nietzsche from Stoic roots

text: The Stoics practiced negative visualization: briefly imagining the loss of what you have, to feel real gratitude for it now. What did you take for granted today that negative visualization would have restored your appreciation for?
A Stoic exercise: treat every person you meet as if it might be the last time you see them, and let that govern your patience. Who did you meet today, and did you treat them accordingly?
The Stoics distinguished between what is 'up to us' (our judgments, intentions, desires) and 'not up to us' (our body, reputation, external events). Where today did you confuse the two?
A Stoic asks each evening: to what fault of mine did I find a remedy today? What fault, however small, did you actually work to correct today?
The obstacle is the way: what stands in the path becomes the path itself. What obstacle today, looked at differently, was actually the work you needed to do?
The Stoics held that anger is a form of temporary madness, since it hands your judgment over to the very thing that wronged you. Did anger today borrow your judgment, even briefly?
source: Stoic practice, after Seneca's On Anger

text: A Stoic practice: before reacting, pause and ask whether the thing in front of you is within your control. What did you react to today before asking that question?

Sympatheia: the idea that all things are interconnected, part of one whole, and that we owe each other cooperation as parts of the same body. Where today did you act as though you were separate from everyone around you?
The Stoics practiced 'self-forgetting' in service of a larger cause. What did you set your own comfort aside for today, in service of something bigger?
A Stoic asks: is this within my power, or does it belong to fortune? What today did you mistake for fortune's business when it was actually yours?
The Stoics taught that time is the one truly irreplaceable resource. How did today's use of time compare to how you'd spend it if you knew its true scarcity?
source: Stoic practice, after Seneca's On the Shortness of Life

text: The Stoic virtue of temperance: moderation not as denial, but as clear-headed choice. Where today did you choose moderation deliberately, rather than by accident or by force?
The Stoic virtue of justice asks what is owed to others, not just what is owed to you. What did you owe someone today, and did you pay it?
The Stoic virtue of courage is not the absence of fear but right action in spite of it. What fear did you act through today, rather than around?
The Stoic virtue of wisdom is knowing what is actually good, bad, and indifferent. What did you treat as urgent today that was really indifferent?
A Stoic exercise: view today's frustration as a training partner sent to strengthen your patience, not an enemy sent to defeat you. Who or what served as your training partner today?
The Stoics remind us that we borrow, not own, everything we have, including our own lives. What did you hold a little too tightly today, forgetting it was only ever on loan?
A Stoic practice: ask not 'why is this happening to me' but 'what does this situation ask of me.' What did today's hardest moment actually ask of you?
The Stoics distinguished the role we are given from the role we choose to play within it. What role did life hand you today, and how well did you play it?
source: Stoic practice, after Epictetus's discourse on roles

text: A Stoic reminder: reputation is not in your control, only your own conduct is. Whose opinion of you did you chase today, at the cost of your own conduct?
The Stoics saw philosophy as a discipline of daily practice, not a subject to master once and set aside. What did you practice today, however imperfectly?
A Stoic exercise: imagine explaining your actions today to someone you deeply respect. Would you need to leave anything out?
The Stoics taught that indifferents - health, money, reputation - are to be used well, not chased at the cost of character. What indifferent thing did you chase too hard today?
A Stoic asks: did I act today as a citizen of the world, or only as a citizen of my own concerns? Which was it today?
source: Stoic practice, after Marcus Aurelius's cosmopolitanism

text: The Stoics practiced gratitude not as a feeling to wait for, but as a discipline to perform daily. What did you deliberately give thanks for today, rather than waiting to feel grateful?
A Stoic reminder: the body is not you, only the vessel you use. What did you let the state of your body dictate about your mind today?
The Stoics held that no external circumstance can touch the true self, only your judgments about it can. What external circumstance today felt like it touched you, when really only your judgment did?
A Stoic exercise: rehearse loss deliberately - of a possession, a relationship, a role - to loosen its grip on you now. What would you have held more loosely today, had you rehearsed losing it?
The Stoics believed excellence is a matter of daily choices, not one dramatic decision. What small, undramatic choice today actually reflected your character?
A Stoic exercise: notice the difference between the event and your story about the event. What event today did you conflate with the story you told about it?
The Stoics taught that we should judge ourselves as harshly as we judge others, and others as gently as we judge ourselves. Which direction did you get backwards today?
A Stoic asks: what would the best version of myself have done in this exact moment? Did today's version of you match that standard?

The Stoics held that death is not to be feared but simply to be expected, like any other natural event. What did today's brush with mortality, however small, teach you about how you're spending your days?
A Stoic exercise: treat setbacks as data, not verdicts. What setback today did you treat as a verdict on your worth, rather than simply information?
The Stoics valued self-command above all comforts. What comfort did you decline today for the sake of self-command?
A Stoic reminder: you cannot control the wind, only the set of your sails. What wind blew against you today, and how did you set your sails?
The Stoics practiced humility by remembering how small a role each of us plays in a vast whole. Where did today's ego outgrow the actual size of your role?
A Stoic asks each night: what did I do today that I'm proud a stranger might have witnessed? What would that stranger have seen?
The Stoics distinguished between grief that honors a loss and grief that refuses to accept reality. Which kind of grief, if any, did today ask of you?
A Stoic exercise: speak to yourself today as you would speak to a friend in the same situation. Did your inner voice today meet that standard?
The Stoics taught that true freedom is wanting only what is within your power to have. What did you want today that was never within your power?
A Stoic exercise: ask what part of today's problem was actually your responsibility, and act only on that part. Which part of today's problem was truly yours to fix?
The Stoics believed that habits of thought are as trainable as habits of the body. What thought pattern did you train today, for better or worse?
A Stoic reminder: comparison steals contentment faster than almost anything else. Who did you compare yourself to today, and what did it cost you?
The Stoics held that every interaction is a chance to practice virtue, even the smallest ones. What small interaction today did you treat as beneath your attention?
A Stoic exercise: separate the facts of what happened from your interpretation of what it means. What facts today got buried under your interpretation of them?
The Stoics taught that the wise are disturbed by nothing, because they've already accepted what they cannot change. What did you refuse to accept today, and at what cost?
A Stoic reminder: your reaction to criticism reveals more about you than the criticism reveals about the critic. What did your reaction to today's criticism reveal about you?
The Stoics distinguished acting for approval from acting for its own rightness. Did you act today for approval, or because it was right regardless of who saw it?
A Stoic exercise: consider that everyone who wronged you today acted out of their own confusion, not malice. Does that change how you carry it tonight?
The Stoics valued consistency between private and public conduct. Were you the same person today in private as you were in public?
A Stoic reminder: worry changes nothing about tomorrow, only how you experience today. How much of today did worry actually cost you?
The Stoics taught that virtue alone is sufficient for a good life, needing no external validation. What virtue did you practice today without anyone noticing?
A Stoic exercise: before speaking in anger, silently count to ten and ask if the words are still necessary. Did you pause before today's sharpest words?
source: Stoic practice, after Seneca's counsel on delay

text: The Stoics believed a well-examined day is worth more than a long, unexamined life. How closely did you examine today, rather than let it simply pass?
A Stoic reminder: the opinions of the crowd change like weather; character should not. Did your character hold steady today, regardless of who was watching?
The Stoics taught that pain is real, but suffering is often a story we add on top of it. What pain today did you turn into unnecessary suffering with the story you told about it?
A Stoic exercise: treat today's inconvenience as an assigned exercise in patience, not an interruption of your real life. What inconvenience today was actually the exercise itself?
The Stoics reminded themselves daily that they would encounter difficult people, and resolved in advance not to be surprised by them. Who tested that resolve today?
source: Stoic practice, after Marcus Aurelius's morning meditation

text: A Stoic asks: if I lost this tomorrow, would I have appreciated it enough today? What did you under-appreciate today that you might not always have?
The Stoics believed that complaining changes nothing but your own state of mind, and rarely for the better. What did you complain about today that complaining did nothing to fix?
A Stoic exercise: separate what you did from how it turned out, and judge yourself only on the former. Did you judge yourself today by your effort, or only by the result?
The Stoics taught that every difficult person is also a teacher, whether or not they intend to be. What did today's most difficult person teach you, intentionally or not?
A Stoic reminder: possessions are held in trust from fortune, and fortune may reclaim them at any time. What are you holding in trust today that you sometimes mistake for permanently yours?
The Stoics valued brevity and honesty of speech over eloquence. Where today did you choose eloquence over simple honesty?
A Stoic exercise: before judging someone's action, consider the constraints they were acting under. Whose action today did you judge without first considering their constraints?
The Stoics believed the truest test of character is how you act when no one is watching. What did you do today when no one was watching?
A Stoic reminder: every day is a small life, complete with its own beginning, middle, and end. How did today's small life begin, and how is it ending?
The Stoics taught that anxiety is often just imagination rehearsing disaster on a loop. What disaster did your imagination rehearse today that never happened?
A Stoic exercise: ask what a person of real integrity would have done in today's hardest moment, and compare it honestly to what you did. How close was the match?
The Stoics believed self-control in small matters builds the strength needed for the large ones. What small act of self-control today was really practice for something bigger?
A Stoic reminder: you do not control outcomes, only effort and intention. Where did you judge today by its outcome instead of by your effort?
The Stoics taught patience with the slow growth of virtue, since character is built in years, not days. Did you extend yourself patience today for the ways you're still a work in progress?
The Stoics taught that we suffer most from clinging to what was never ours to keep. What did you cling to today that was already, by nature, on loan?

It is in our power to have no opinion about a thing, and not to be disturbed in our soul; for things themselves have no natural power to form our judgments. What judgment did you form too quickly today, before pausing to ask if it was necessary at all?

Begin each day by telling yourself: today I shall meet with people who are meddling, ungrateful, and unjust — yet none of this can harm the one thing that is truly mine, my own character. Did your character stay untouched by whoever tested it today?
